scope: Header-only POC, whole framebuffer bytes/cursor/alias equality and actual MIPS software execution instruction/store counts. Counts are not hardware cycles or a game FPS claim.

native.measurement_method: Fresh independent VM per variant; exact valid Configure state supplied as kernel input before first execution; UC_HOOK_CODE installed before any translation, counts entire entry, loops, callees, delay slots. Separate fresh VM LCD-address-only UC_HOOK_MEM_WRITE verifies writes and identical full output; avoids Unicorn global stack-write-hook delay-slot exception.
native.scope_limit: Instruction reductions are not hardware cycles; unchanged volatile LCD writes may dominate bus time. No game FPS improvement claimed until device measurement.
